description: A task still works on this artifact or made it: remove the task first.
The address of a machine or of its drill head node is missing or is not host:port.
The description of an artifact does not fit (name, format, result_type, inputs or params).
board_mm is not from 0 to 50.
The tuning text of the machine does not read.
The name or the password is wrong.
The days a token lasts are not a number from 1 to 3650.
The text of DRILLPRO.DCF or ROUTEPRO.RCF does not read.
A line of the G-code program cannot be sent (control characters, a $ line that is not allowed, a line too long).
A hole has a coordinate that is not a number.
The id of a machine is not made of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 32).
The query of the ring of LEDs of the drill head is not valid.
A name is empty, too long or has characters that are not allowed.
The drilling file does not read.
The parameters of a task do not fit its engine, are not an object, or the idempotency key is not valid.
A point of a path has a coordinate that is not a number.
The picture the camera of the drill head sent cannot be read.
The inspection profile is not valid.
The body of the request does not read as the request needs.
The number of samples of a measurement is out of range.
A scope of a token is not one the server knows.
The set-up code is wrong, or the server already has a user.
The sharing does not fit: give a user or a token, not the owner, with an access that exists for it.
The sorting of the holes is not one the program knows.
The spindle, the switch or the limits of a spindle are not valid.
The station of a machine is not made of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (up to 32).
The template of a token is not phoenix, cam, client or custom.
A tool has values out of range.
The declaration of an upload or one of its parts does not fit (hash, empty part, a part past the declared size).
The bytes of an artifact are missing or are not what their hash says.
The job brings the work as data and as files; it must be one of them.
The kind of task is known but this build has no engine for it.
The role of the caller is not enough for this request.
The token is limited to scopes that do not include this one, or a token of a design program was asked for a scope of the machines.
The bytes of the upload do not have the SHA-256 that was declared; the upload is discarded.
The node of the drill head answered with a refusal.
The node of the drill head does not answer.
The idempotency key was already used by this caller for a request with another body.
A task of the server failed; the server is still up.
The job is running: stop it first.
The last administrator cannot be deleted, disabled or demoted.
While the server has no user, only the computer it runs on may make the first administrator.
A job is running on the machine.
A machine with this id already exists.
A job is running: the update would restart the server and stop it.
The machine has no node of the drill head.
The picture of the drill head shows no hole to calibrate with.
No quality check has been made on this machine since the server started.
The artifact a task works on does not exist or cannot be seen.
The job has no holes, no paths and no lines to run.
The job is neither ready nor running.
A job is held while it runs and resumed while it is held.
Only a G-code job can be held.
The job already ran or is running.
The job is not running.
Only a cancelled or failed job can be gone on from.
A hole or a path is outside the table of the machine.
The work goes past the course of an axis (the machine's switch is on reject).
As many tasks are waiting or running as the server accepts (max_tasks).
The caller already has as many tasks waiting or running as one user may (tasks_per_user).
Sharing is switched off on this server (shares_enabled).
The job asks for more than the spindle of the machine gives (the machine's switch is on reject).
The revision does not follow the last one of the project: look at what changed first.
The data folder could not be written.
The inspection profile could not be saved.
The artifact store would pass artifact_store_gb.
The task has not finished: cancel it first.
The computing tasks are switched off on this server (tasks_enabled).
Too many wrong passwords, or too many tickets waiting: try again later.
The request or the work is bigger than the server accepts (413 for a body over max_body_mb).
More holes than one inspection takes.
The token is missing, not valid or has expired.
There is no artifact with this id, or it belongs to somebody else.
There is no job with this id.
There is no such kind of task.
There is no machine with this id.
There is no project with this id, or it belongs to somebody else.
There is no task with this id, or it belongs to somebody else.
There is no token with this id.
The job uses a tool that it does not describe.
There is no upload with this id, or it belongs to somebody else.
There is no user with this name.
The update helper refused the request.
The updates are not set up on this server (updates_dir).
A part carries other bytes than the ones already received at the same place.
Parts are still missing: the upload cannot be completed.
A user with this name already exists.
The password is not from 8 to 128 characters.
The job is of a kind the machine does not take.
